title: Caching in 60 seconds
caption: Caching in 60 seconds: keeping answers close so you don't work them out twice. #caching #performance #backend

scenes.title: Caching
scenes.say: The fastest computation is the one you never do.
scenes.sub: The fastest computation is the one you never do.

scenes.say: Asking the database the same question a thousand times a second is slow, and it's the same answer every time.
So you keep a copy in fast memory, like Redis.

items.title: Hit
items.say: If it's there, return it. Done.

items.title: Miss
items.text: ask the database, then store it
items.say: If not, ask the database, and store the answer for next time.

scenes.code:
SET user:42 "{...}" EX 60

# user changes their name
# → cache still says the old one
scenes.say: The hard part is staleness. When data changes, the copy is wrong until it expires or you clear it.

scenes.text: This video uses it: kaviri *caches every narrated line*, so a re-render only pays for what changed.
scenes.say: This video uses it too. kaviri caches every narrated line, so a re-render only pays for what changed.
